verdict.rationale: The pack shows Intuit's OAuth 2.0 client with token management, but it never documents issuing scoped or least-privilege credentials, such as per-token scopes or restricted API keys. The official MCP server's write/update-disable toggles and tool-category restrictions are server configuration switches, not scoped credentials. Custom user roles apply to human users, not API credentials. These are adjacent controls and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
